policy.name: vPortYield
policy.reason: FreeRTOS Cortex-R port hand assembly (portASM.S), no .su and no CFI: `svc 0; isb; bx lr`: the SVC handler runs on the SVC-mode stack, not the task's, so no frame on the task stack. Read from the disassembly of the mps3-an536 image (issue 2818)

policy.name: vPortRestoreTaskContext
policy.reason: FreeRTOS Cortex-R port hand assembly (portASM.S), no .su and no CFI: loads the first task's own `sp` and `rfeia`s into it; it never returns to its caller's stack, so no frame on the task stack. Read from the disassembly of the mps3-an536 image (issue 2818)
